sections.heading: What the official information establishes
sections.text: Designated backpack sites require hiking or biking in every supply. There are no showers, and trash must be packed out.

sections.heading: How we would choose
sections.text: Practice carrying a loaded pack before choosing Newport for a first family trip. The carrying requirement matters more than the number of campsite amenities. If someone needs frequent access to the car, compare Peninsula instead.

sections.heading: Before reserving
sections.text: Plan water carrying and the route from parking before reserving.

sections.heading: A workable weekend
sections.text: Friday: arrive with enough daylight to find the pad, unpack and prepare a simple meal. Saturday: choose one main outing, then leave a flexible afternoon for rest or an activity that suits the weather. Sunday: dry and pack equipment, collect every piece of waste and leave time for the departure routine. This is an editorial planning framework, not a timed route or a report of a personal stay.

sections.heading: Equipment and rental considerations
sections.text: Borrow or rent the equipment you need before buying a complete setup. For a tent stay, prioritize a weather-appropriate shelter, sleeping insulation and headlamps. For a rented RV, confirm the exact pad length, hookups, access and written delivery permission with the park and the rental owner. We have not tested products or verified rental inventory for this profile.

nearby.name: Rainy-day plan
nearby.note: Check current visitor-facility hours. Bring indoor games and identify a suitable indoor stop before leaving; a picnic shelter is not a storm shelter.
